title: Consumer cluster.yaml — declarative cluster Source-of-Truth
description: Shape of a consumer cluster.yaml (see cluster.yaml.example). Mirrors the tofu/modules/talos-cluster variable validations for the structured surface (images / hardware-capabilities / nodes / identity / versions); the free-form Talos config_patches and substrate.*.values_override passthroughs stay loosely typed and are NOT content-validated here. Secrets (sops_age_key, cilium_ipsec_key) have no TOP-LEVEL slot by design; the open substrate.* and *config_patches passthroughs are guarded by gitleaks, not this schema. Forged reserved labels inside free-form config_patches are the downstream-Kyverno boundary, not a schema concern.
$comment: No schema_version field by design: cluster.yaml carries none, and the schema is versioned by its $id + the base OCI tag (a breaking shape change bumps the next tag's MAJOR per AGENTS.md/CHANGELOG). Migration signal = OCI tag, not an in-file version.

name.description: Talos cluster name (PKI CN) and ArgoCD Application/Project name. Lowercase RFC-1123 label.

endpoint.description: Kubernetes API endpoint, an https:// URL including the port.

overlay.description: kustomize overlay name under kubernetes/overlays/ (read by task bootstrap:argocd).

target_revision.description: git branch/tag for the ArgoCD root Application (read by task bootstrap:argocd).

pod_cidr.description: Pod network CIDR(s). One entry single-stack; v4+v6 when dual_stack.

url.description: Consumer cluster repo URL (read by task bootstrap:argocd).

version.description: Talos machine-config schema pin — v-prefixed semver, fixed at bootstrap.

install_version.description: Installer-image tag for OS upgrades. Empty = matches talos.version.

images.description: Per-image installer base. Key = image id referenced by node.image.

hardware-capabilities.description: Composable, tool-agnostic node capabilities. Key = capability id referenced by node.hardware_capabilities. May be empty.

config_patches.description: Cluster-wide Talos machine-config patches (free-form YAML maps).

controlplane_config_patches.description: Controlplane-only Talos machine-config patches (free-form YAML maps).

worker_config_patches.description: Worker-only Talos machine-config patches (free-form YAML maps).

substrate.description: Layer-1 substrate delivery (Cilium + ArgoCD; cert-approver is boot-glue). The per-tool keys are loosely typed and the set is open — the long tail (values_override, encryption, …) and future substrate tools are intentionally not enumerated.

architecture.description: Installer-image architecture. Defaults to amd64 in the module when omitted.

cpu_vendor.description: Resolves a profile's vendor variants (e.g. iommu intel vs amd). REQUIRED, no default.

extensions.description: Baseline Image-Factory system extensions baked on every node of this image.

overlay.description: ARM single-board-computer board overlay. Null/omitted for x86/metal nodes.

requires_features.description: Layer-C atom ids for scheduling / labels.

provisioning_profiles.description: Ids of base catalog profiles to apply (drbd, iommu, nvidia-lts, …). Explicit.

emits_label.description: Node label set when a node holds this capability. MUST be in the platform.io/hardware-capability.* namespace (reserved hardware-feature.* labels come only from a profile's provides).

hostname.description: Unique node hostname; keys the per-node apply resource.

ip.description: Unique node IP reachable on the Talos API port.

role.description: Kubernetes node role. Hardware specialisation is a capability, NOT a role.

image.description: Must be a key in images.

hardware_capabilities.description: Set of capability ids (keys in hardware-capabilities) this node holds.

config_patches.description: Per-node Talos machine-config patches (free-form YAML maps).
